preconditions.description: All characters in the input string are lowercase.
The input string is not empty.
All characters in the input string are alphabetic.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string is the same as the input string.
All characters in the output string are lowercase.
All characters in the output string are alphabetic.

postconditions.expression: all((c in 'aeiou' and ord(return_value[i]) == (ord(c) - 5) % 26 + ord('a')) or (c not in 'aeiou' and c != 'c' and c != 'o' and c != 'd' and c != 'e' and ord(return_value[i]) == (ord(c) + 9) % 26 + ord('a')) or (c == 'c' and ord(return_value[i]) == ord(c) - 1) or (c == 'o' and ord(return_value[i]) == ord(c) - 1) or (c == 'd' and ord(return_value[i]) == ord(c) - 3) or (c == 'e' and ord(return_value[i]) == ord(c) - 4) for i, c in enumerate(s))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is determined by moving vowels back 5 places, consonants forward 9 places, and applying specific exceptions for 'c', 'o', 'd', and 'e'.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] in 'aeiou' and ord(s[i]) == (ord(return_value[i]) + 5) % 26 + ord('a')) or (return_value[i] not in 'aeiou' and return_value[i] != 'c' and return_value[i] != 'o' and return_value[i] != 'd' and return_value[i] != 'e' and ord(s[i]) == (ord(return_value[i]) - 9) % 26 + ord('a')) or (return_value[i] == 'c' and ord(s[i]) == ord(return_value[i]) + 1) or (return_value[i] == 'o' and ord(s[i]) == ord(return_value[i]) + 1) or (return_value[i] == 'd' and ord(s[i]) == ord(return_value[i]) + 3) or (return_value[i] == 'e' and ord(s[i]) == ord(return_value[i]) + 4) for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Reversing the transformation applied to each character in the output string returns the original input string.
